messages:
maria: Quick async question about embeddings endpoint behavior — preparing a short doc for SDKs. Need to lock down a few contract details before I open the PR.
akshay: sure, list them out. I can help verify server behavior and add tests.
tj: ping me for the SDK surface changes. Also can add validation in the client.
maria: top items:
1) Input types: do we accept null/None/empty-string items in the input array? Expected behavior: preserve ordering, return a 0-vector or omit? Need a server-side spec.
2) Truncation: what exact policy do we apply when tokens exceed model limit (e.g., 8192)? Do we truncate per-item or split items? Any sentinel handling for truncation?
3) Batch limits: max items per request and max total characters/token budget. Current runtime has a soft 512 items/req and hard token budget per-batch. Want exact numbers for SDK docs.
4) Output shape: guarantee embed length == model_dim (e.g., "768") and always return list of floats for each input, even for empty/null inputs. Confirm for backward compatibility.

akshay: Answers from infra/serving side:
- Input types: server accepts mixed types but canonicalizes to string. For `null` items we currently return a vector of zeros (same dim) and preserve the slot. This was done to keep positional mapping for downstream consumers.
- Truncation: we truncate per-item (right-truncate) to the model token limit minus a small safety margin (default 16 tokens) and annotate `truncated: true` in the per-item metadata in streaming responses. We don't auto-split items into multiple embeddings for now.
- Batch limits: soft limit is 512 items; hard enforced limit is 1024. There's also a per-batch token budget (sum of tokenized lengths) currently set to 1e6 tokens. Exceeding the soft limit will yield a 429 with a Retry-After; exceeding hard limit returns 400.
- Output shape: always returns a vector of length equal to the model_dim. For legacy models with 1024->768 change we return the model's dimension; clients should not assume fixed size across model versions.

maria: thanks — a couple followups:
- can we make the `truncated` annotation part of the base JSON response (non-streaming) too? SDKs need a single response shape for sync calls.
- zeros for null items: is that documented anywhere? I couldn't find it in the API spec.

akshay: yes to `truncated` in sync responses — we pushed a small change last week. Non-streaming response will include an array `items_meta` aligned with inputs. Example:
```
{
  "embeddings": [[...], [...]],
  "items_meta": [{"truncated": false}, {"truncated": true}]
}
```
I will add the note about `null` -> zero-vector to the spec.

tj: note for SDKs: preserve positional mapping even if we return zeros. Many customers rely on index alignment. Also add a helper `strip_empty_items` option in client that will convert null/empty to placeholders if user prefers to drop them — default false.

maria: sounds good. Another edge: empty-string vs whitespace-only string — do we token-count and return zeros for whitespace-only? Sara's evals hit a case.

akshay: whitespace-only is normalized to empty-string server-side. empty-string and whitespace-only both map to zero-length tokenization and we return a zero-vector. I'll add a test.

sara: re: backward compatibility — some users expect embed length 1024; we should include model_dim in the response top-level as `model_dim` so clients can programmatically adapt. Otherwise silent changes break consumers.

akshay: good call. We can add `model_dim` (int) and `model_id` top-level fields. We'll keep `embeddings` as list-of-lists. Migration note: if model_dim changes between releases, we will document it in the change log and mark as breaking in the model catalog.

maria: CR and docs plan:
- akshay, can you open a small PR that updates the API spec JSON schema (add items_meta, model_dim) + tests for null/whitespace? Link it here.
- tj, I'll open the SDK PR to read `model_dim` and to add `strip_empty_items` helper.
- I'll also add a short note in the changelog about the `zero-vector for null/empty` policy.

akshay: will do today. CR will be tagged `ENG-embed-contract-17425`.

tj: I'll aim to land SDK changes in the next sprint. Will flag the CR for review once it's up. :eyes:

dev-bot: Build status: CI passed for infra tests on branch update/embeddings-contract (react: :white_check_mark:)

maria: awesome — thanks everyone. If anyone sees other edge cases (multipart inputs, chunking requests in client), drop them here. I'll file a follow-up if needed.
